answer: Every claim climbs the delta of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the orchard re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the cedar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
